summary_en: The diocese of Timisoara (Romania) is allowed, for pastoral reasons, to keep some celebrations on the days they had before the reformed Roman Calendar.

celebration.name_latin: S. Ioseph Sponsus B. Mariae Virginis

summary_en: St Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, is confirmed as patron of the city of Antofagasta (Chile).
excerpt: Antofagastensis in Chilia, 22 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 686/75): confirmatur electio S. Ioseph B. Mariae Virginis Sponsi civitatis Antofagastensis apud Deum Patroni.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the prelature nullius of Acquaviva delle Fonti (Italy) listed under Calendaria particularia; the same decree confirms the Italian text of the Proper of Masses (p. 12).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the dioceses of Argentina, listed under Calendaria particularia (decree of 31 July 1975).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Colle di Val d'Elsa (Collensis, Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.

summary_en: In the diocese of Chur the celebration of Sts Placidus and Sigisbert may be transferred from 11 July to 12 July.
excerpt: Curiensis, 20 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 589/75): conceditur ut in dioecesi Curiensi celebratio SS. Placidi et Sigisberti transferri valeat a die 11 ad diem 12 iulii.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Lodi (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia. The page prints the same protocol number (CD 589/75) and date as the preceding Curiensis line, which is probably a misprint; the id carries a -2 suffix to stay unique.

celebration.name_latin: B. Arnoldus Janssen; B. Maria Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde

summary_en: The diocese of Muenster may inscribe in its calendar, as optional memorials, Bl. Arnold Janssen and Bl. Maria Droste zu Vischering of the Divine Heart (the same decree confirms the German Mass texts, p. 11).
excerpt: Monasteriensis, 3 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 822/75): conceditur ut in Calendario dioecesis inscribi valeant tamquam memoriae ad libitum celebrationes B. Arnoldi Janssen et B. Mariae Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Nardo (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Neritonensis, 27 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 525/75).

summary_en: Regional particular calendar of the dioceses of the Piceno region (Marche, Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia; a multi-diocese region within one nation, recorded with level other.

target.institute: Ordines Fratrum S. Augustini et Augustinianorum Recollectorum

summary_en: The Order of St Augustine and the Augustinian Recollects may inscribe Bl. Ezekiel Moreno in their particular calendar as an obligatory memorial (the same decree confirms his Mass and Office texts, p. 13).

target.institute: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B. Mariae Virginis Immaculatae

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Oblates of Mary Immaculate is confirmed, and it may be inserted either into the General Roman Calendar or into the calendar of the local Church, the choice being made at the level of the religious province or a wider circumscription by the competent superiors.

CD 741/75): confirmatur Calendarium particulare atque conceditur ut idem Calendarium inseri valeat sive in Calendarium Romanum generale sive in Calendarium Ecclesiae localis, dummodo electio circa Calendarium adhibendum fiat in ambitu religiosae Provinciae vel amplioris dicionis a Superioribus competentibus.

target.institute: Sorores Dominae nostrae a Caritate Boni Pastoris

celebration.name_latin: B. Maria Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde

summary_en: The Sisters of Our Lady of Charity of the Good Shepherd may inscribe Bl. Maria Droste zu Vischering of the Divine Heart in their particular calendar as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Sorores Dominae nostrae a Caritate Boni Pastoris, 24 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 659/75): conceditur ut celebratio B. Mariae Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde in Calendario particulari inscribi valeat tamquam memoria obligatoria.

target.institute: Religiosae Mariae Immaculatae

celebration.name_latin: S. Vincentia Maria Lopez y Vicuña

summary_en: The Religious of Mary Immaculate may celebrate St Vicenta Maria Lopez y Vicuna each year on 25 May according to the norms of the Roman Calendar.
excerpt: Religiosae Mariae Immaculatae, 29 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 838/75): conceditur ut celebratio S. Vincentiae Mariae Lopez y Vicuña, quotannis die 25 maii, secundum normas Calendarii Romani, peragi valeat.

target.institute: Sorores Pretiosissimi Sanguinis

summary_en: The Sisters of the Most Precious Blood may celebrate the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ on 1 July as a solemnity.
excerpt: Sorores Pretiosissimi Sanguinis, 10 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 740/75): conceditur ut celebratio Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D.N.I.C. peragi valeat die 1 iulii tamquam sollemnitas.

celebration.name_latin: S. Ambrosius, episcopus et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: St Ambrose, bishop and doctor of the Church, is confirmed as patron of the Lombardy region (Italy); a regional (multi-diocese) patronage, recorded with level other.
excerpt: Regio Longobardica in Italia, 11 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 711/75): confirmatur electio S. Ambrosii Episcopi et Ecclesiae Doctoris apud Deum Patroni Regionis Longobardiae.

summary_en: Bl. Vincent Grossi is inscribed in the proper calendar of the Church of Lodi, to be celebrated each year on 7 November as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Laudensis, 21 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 48/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Vincentii Grossi in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Laudensis inseratur, quotannis die 7 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Bl. Joseph Moscati is inscribed in the proper calendar of the Church of Salerno, to be celebrated each year on 12 April as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Salernitana, 21 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 86/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioseph Moscati in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Salernitanae inseratur, quotannis die 12 aprilis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska is inserted in the calendar of the archdiocese of Salzburg, to be celebrated each year on 6 July as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Salisburgensis, 2 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 126/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Teresiae Ledochowska, in Calendarium Archidioecesis Salisburgensis inseratur, quotannis die 6 iulii tamquam memoria ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska may be inscribed in the calendar of the diocese of Sankt Poelten on 6 July as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Sancti Hippolyti, 3 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 141/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Theresiae Ledochowska in Calendario dioecesis Sancti Hippolyti die 6 iulii tamquam memoria ad libitum ascribi valeat.

summary_en: In the city of Priverno and in the abbey of Fossanova (diocese of Terracina-Latina-Priverno-Sezze) St Thomas Aquinas may be celebrated on 7 March as a solemnity, under n. 21 of the Instruction Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Terracinensis, Latinensis, Privernensis et Setinae, 22 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 73/76): ad normam n. 21 Instr. Calendaria particularia conceditur ut celebratio S. Thomae de Aquino, in civitate Privernensi et in Abbatia Fossanovae, peragi valeat die 7 martii gradu sollemnitatis.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Order of St Augustine for Italy and Malta is confirmed (the same decree confirms the Latin and Italian Proper texts, p. 54).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini, 23 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 705/75): confirmatur Calendarium particulare pro Italia et Melita.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Sardiniae

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Sardinian province of the Order of Friars Minor is confirmed.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, 24 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 95/76): confirmatur Calendarium particulare Provinciae Sardiniae eiusdem Ordinis.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, Provincia Umbriae

summary_en: Particular celebrations are confirmed for the Umbrian province of the Capuchins: St Veronica Giuliani as an obligatory memorial (9 July in the houses of the diocese of Citta di Castello, with Sts Nicholas Pick, Willehad and companions on 10 July; elsewhere as in the common Franciscan calendar for Italy confirmed 8 July 1973, Prot. 855/73), and St Joseph of Leonessa as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, 4 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 145/76): confirmantur celebrationes particulares pro Provincia Umbriae eiusdem Ordinis, nempe: S. Veronicae Giuliani memoria obligatoria [...] S. Iosephi a Leonessa memoria obligatoria

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska is confirmed as patroness of the missionary works in Poland.
excerpt: Polonia, 20 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 814/75): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Teresiae Ledochowska apud Deum Patrona operibus missionalibus in Polonia addictorum.

summary_en: The diocese of Aachen may insert in its calendar the optional memorial of Bl. Arnold Janssen on 15 January.
excerpt: Aquisgranensis, 26 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 276/76): conceditur ut memoria ad libitum Beati Arnoldi Janssen, quotannis die 15 ianuarii celebranda, in calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Belley (France), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin and French Proper texts, p. 95).
excerpt: Bellicensis, 24 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 258/76).

summary_en: In the calendar of the archdiocese of Salerno the obligatory memorial of St Alferius is transferred from 12 April to 5 October.
excerpt: Salernitana, 26 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 255/76): conceditur ut in calendarium archidioecesis memoria obligatoria S. Alpherii e die 12 aprilis ad diem 5 octobris transferri valeat.

target.institute: Congregatio Casinensis, O.S.B.

summary_en: In all monasteries of the Cassinese Benedictine Congregation the celebration of St Benedict may be held each year on 21 March.

excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Lyciensis Assumptionis B.M.V., 25 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 223/75): conceditur ut celebratio B. Aegidii Mariae a S. Ioseph die 7 februarii quotannis celebrari valeat gradu memoriae obligatoriae.

target.institute: Congregatio Oblatorum B.M.V.

celebration.name_latin: SS. Carolus Lwanga et socii, martyres

excerpt: Africa Meridionalis dioeceses, 13 martii 1976 (Prot. CD 324/76): conceditur ut in Africa Meridionali celebratio liturgica Sanctorum Caroli Lwanga et sociorum quotannis die 3 iunii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Pisa (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Vercelli (Piedmont, Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia; the same decree confirms the Italian Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours (pp. 366-367).
excerpt: Vercellensis, 15 sept. 1976 (Prot. CD 1182/76).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Lyon (France), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Lugdunensis, 27 sept. 1976 (Prot. CD 1223/76).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Mondonedo-Ferrol (Spain), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin, Spanish and Galician Proper texts, p. 366).
excerpt: Mindoniensis - Ferrolensis, 29 sept. 1976 (Prot. CD 522/76).

summary_en: The regional calendar of the dioceses of the Piedmont region (Italy) is confirmed; a multi-diocese region within one nation, recorded with level other (the same decree confirms the regional Proper texts, p. 367).
excerpt: Pedemontanae Regionis dioeceses in Italia, 4 sept. 1976 (Prot. CD 883/76): confirmatur Calendarium Regionale.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Sancti Augustini

summary_en: Some liturgical celebrations of the Order of St Augustine in Italy may be transferred for the year 1977 only.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Sancti Augustini, 16 sept. 1976 (Prot. CD 1159/76): conceditur ut aliquae celebrationes liturgicae eiusdem Ordinis in Italia, pro anno 1977, transferri valeant.

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Our Lady of Guadalupe is confirmed as patroness of the diocese of Orange (California).
excerpt: Orangensis, 19 iulii 1976 (Prot. CD 528/76): confirmatur electio B.M.V. sub titulo Dominae Nostrae « de Guadalupe » in Patronam apud Deum eiusdem dioecesis.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Aire et Dax (France), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the French Proper texts, p. 432).
excerpt: Aturensis et Aquensis, 6 decembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1457/76).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the dioceses of Australia, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Australiae Dioeceses, 14 octobris 1976 (Prot. CD 1264/76).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Brindisi (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin and Italian Proper of Masses, p. 433).
excerpt: Brundusina, 11 novembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1120/76).

summary_en: In the diocese of Castellaneta the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of Graces, patroness of Palagianello, may be celebrated each year on 31 May with the texts of the Visitation.
excerpt: Castellanetensis, 24 novembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1133/76): conceditur ut sollemnitas B.V.M. Matris Gratiarum, Patronae loci v.d. « Palagianello », quotannis die 31 maii, in Visitatione B. Mariae Virginis, peragi valeat, textibus liturgicis adhibitis, qui in Missali Romano et in Liturgia Horarum inveniuntur.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Otranto (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Hydruntina, 25 octobris 1976 (Prot. CD 68/76).

summary_en: In the diocese of Reggio Emilia the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Madonna della Ghiara may be held on 29 April and the feast of St Catherine of Siena on 30 April.
excerpt: Regiensis in Aemilia, 9 novembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1373/76): conceditur ut celebratio B.V.M. sub titulo « Madonna della Ghiara » die 29 aprilis atque festum S. Catharinae Senensis die 30 aprilis quotannis peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Segovia (Spain), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin Proper texts, p. 433).
excerpt: Segobiensis, 6 decembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1251/76).

target.institute: Ordo B. Mariae Virginis de Mercede

summary_en: The Mercedarians may celebrate the solemnity of St Hadrian, titular of the Roman parish church of that name together with Our Lady of Mercy, in that church each year on 10 September.
excerpt: Ordo B. Mariae Virginis de Mercede, 25 octobris 1976 (Prot. CD 1209/76): conceditur ut sollemnitas S. Hadriani, titularis una cum B.M.V. de Mercede paroeciae romanae eiusdem nominis, in eadem ecclesia paroeciali die 10 septembris quotannis celebrari valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, Provincia Veneta

celebration.name_latin: B. Leopoldus Bogdan Mandić a Castronovo

summary_en: Bl. Leopold Bogdan Mandic of Castelnovo may be celebrated in the whole Venetian province of the Capuchins on 30 July with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, 4 decembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1451/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Leopoldi Bogdan Mandić a Castronovo peragi possit in tota Provincia Veneta eiusdem Ordinis die 30 iulii gradu festi.

target.institute: Ordo Scholarum Piarum

summary_en: The Piarists may celebrate St Joseph Calasanz each year on 25 August (the day fixed for him in the General Roman Calendar); the decree does not state the previous date.
excerpt: Ordo Scholarum Piarum, 11 novembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1398/76): conceditur ut celebratio S. Iosephi de Calasanz quotannis die 25 augusti peragi possit.

target.institute: Congregatio Monialium O.S.B. ab adoratione Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu de « Montmartre »

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Benedictine nuns of the Adoration of the Sacred Heart of Montmartre, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Congregatio Monialium O.S.B. ab adoratione Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu de « Montmartre », 30 octobris 1976 (Prot. CD 1283/76).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, Provincia Croatica

celebration.name_latin: B. Leopoldus Bogdan Mandić a Castronovo

summary_en: Bl. Leopold Bogdan Mandic of Castelnovo is confirmed as patron of the Croatian province of the Capuchins.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, 13 septembris 1976 (Prot. CD 1131/76): confirmatur electio Beati Leopoldi Bogdan Mandić a Castronovo apud Deum Patroni Provinciae Croaticae eiusdem Ordinis.
